review_reason: The prior prelaunch response REQUIRE_CHANGES has been implemented. This is a new immutable brief for the same frozen scientific question, with an executable no-update worker and CPU-tested postprocessor.
scientific_question: On the reused frozen 60-episode synthetic development cohort, does Family-Balanced improve teacher-forced correct target-token ranking or margin against V7 even where free-running Greedy exact-grid accuracy did not improve?

frozen_conditions.primary: length-bucketed B32 teacher-forced forward; GRID_CONTENT equal-family macro
frozen_conditions.sensitivity: fixed target-blind 12-episode B1 subset; exact discrete rank agreement; continuous margin sensitivity U separately expands only the margin confidence interval

measurement_validity.target_handling: sealed sidecar SHA/map is verified at runtime; grids are serialized only in memory after verification; target token IDs are never written to results
measurement_validity.pairing: raw predictions must contain exactly V7 and Family-Balanced rows per episode with identical prompt SHA256 before B1 subset selection
measurement_validity.model_forward: left-padding, attention mask, position IDs, causal target-logit slice, and FP32 rank/margin extraction are explicit
measurement_validity.result_guards: complete 120 B32 paired rows, complete 24 B1 rows, fresh output, atomic success/failure receipt, preserved partial failure evidence

classification.invalid: identity, target roundtrip/map, row completeness, or discrete B32/B1 disagreement yields INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID
classification.improved: positive adjusted Top-1 interval plus nonnegative Top-2 and margin intervals yields LOCAL_RANKING_IMPROVED_BUT_EXACT_NOT_IMPROVED
classification.otherwise: RANKING_NOT_IMPROVED or INCONCLUSIVE_MIXED_EVIDENCE; this remains reused DEV evidence, not independent ARC transfer confirmation

director_question: Are these repaired runtime, target-isolation, B32/B1 sensitivity, and interpretation controls sufficient to authorize exactly one bounded no-update GPU measurement under the unchanged frozen protocol?
